The market sells proofs one at a time at 117 POA; 554 proofs sell for 64818 POA, and there is no wholesale price. The panel asks for the sable first, the tundra second, and the voyage third, and it waits for all three before deciding. The panel does not argue with farms; it reads the record and closes the file.
